source_review.reason: The runner creates a real text selection on a public page with the extension highlighter active while the real Settings UI shows no selected workspace. It arms transport observation immediately before mouseup, waits for the exact terminal no-workspace write notice before selecting the workspace, and requires both a completed membership RPC positive control and zero highlight-table POSTs. It then selects the approved existing workspace through the real picker and verifies the same failure notice remains visibly rendered with no later highlight POST. No Source-save or D22 checkpoint path is present.
evidence: `workspaceState` requires Choose… and no stored active organization; no organization/session/storage values are injected, and sign-in and organization selection use real UI flows.
The user action is an actual pointer drag over the unique public Example Domain heading; the observer arms before mouseup, which is the highlighter's real persistence event.

Before workspace selection, exact visible notice text must say Highlight not saved, the no-workspace request was never sent, nothing was saved, and to pick a workspace. The observer requires at least one completed HTTP 200 /rest/v1/rpc/mbr_for_user request as a positive control and zero /wbx_highlight POSTs.

Only after that terminal notice does the runner choose the approved organization in the picker. After the bounded 2-second observation, the same unique notice must have non-hidden display/visibility/opacity, nonzero area, viewport intersection, and an unoccluded interior hit point; highlight POST count must remain zero.

The actual failure path is reachable: createHighlight catches the no-organization hold failure and failDbCall raises the typed notice; the runner waits up to 150 seconds against the production 120-second hold before it allows selection.
The script contains no Source Save/Delete action and does not read, create, or alter the D22 private attempt checkpoint. Failure screenshots use unique names, exclusive creation, and mode 0600.
limits: No browser, test, or heavy runtime was run by this source-review lane; native acceptance remains unverified.
The 2-second post-selection interval proves bounded absence of automatic retry, not absence of any retry arbitrarily far in the future.
The test is scoped to admin mode and the Example Domain public fixture; it does not establish member-mode behavior.

runtime.reason: Source review only; no runtime/browser verification was performed.
